E_CONTEXT.locator: Main Introduction; Figs 1-2; Results Complete wave modulation; SI Note 1 pp.3-4
E_CONTEXT.paraphrase: Conventional coiling and real-impedance transmission bounds are analytical context.

E_HORN.locator: Main Figs 3-4; Eqs 14-25; SI Note 3 pp.11-17
E_HORN.paraphrase: Graded channels and equivalent horn model, with analytical and numerical comparison.

E_TMM.paraphrase: Modal transfer matrices and numerical frequency sweep, not physical impedance-tube measurement.

E_DESIGN.locator: Main Results Metasurfaces for complete acoustic wave modulation; SI Table 1 p.1; Note 4 pp.19-20
E_DESIGN.paraphrase: Two 30-cell designs, each specified by 15 rows and mirror symmetry; only focusing design fabricated.

E_FOCUS.paraphrase: Forward focusing at two wavelengths, lossy/lossless simulation.

E_PHYSICAL.locator: Main Fig 6b,c; Fig 7; Results pp.6-7; Methods p.8
E_PHYSICAL.paraphrase: Physical with/without-metasurface mapping of reverse focusing.

E_FAB.locator: Methods Experimental setup and procedure p.8; Fig 7
E_FAB.paraphrase: ABS fabricated with Dimension SST 1200es at reported 0.2 mm resolution.

E_RIG.locator: Methods Experimental setup and procedure p.8; Fig 7
E_RIG.paraphrase: Two plywood sheets, absorbers and speaker with narrow tube.

E_SCAN.locator: Methods Experimental setup and procedure p.8; SI Table 2 p.2
E_SCAN.paraphrase: 190 probe positions, 9 cm spacing, ten transfer-function readouts averaged at each position, two initially calibrated Audix TM1 microphones.

E_TABLE2.paraphrase: Two 19-by-10 averaged complex arrays; raw readouts are not supplied.

E_NUMERICS.paraphrase: COMSOL frequency-domain pressure acoustics, narrow-region loss model, rigid boundaries and PML.

E_PHASE.paraphrase: Numerical ideal phase-only versus phase-amplitude splitting.

E_ACCESSIBLE.paraphrase: Focusing targets against conventional-coiling accessible region.

E_ANALYSIS.paraphrase: Normalization and spline visualization follow acquisition; details incomplete.

dependencies.transport: MOVE is a reusable required custody action for every station change of a carried object. Its actual occurrence must precede destination loading; no self-loop is imposed on the template graph.
dependencies.cycle_semantics: Ten reads and 190 points are bounded occurrence loops, not repeated graph nodes. Two independent condition episodes may be ordered either way.
dependencies.edge_semantics: Unconditional edges apply to the selected branch dependency closure. Condition-scoped edges apply only to their named condition. The one_of requirement never requires both panel-presence states.

operation_policy.ordering: Templates are not historical chronology. Dependencies and occurrence context determine valid order.

branch_policy.order_semantics: Operation lists express membership, not a mandatory historical sequence. Both condition orders are allowed if matched state is maintained.

counts.counts_note: 3800 is arithmetic for an authored complete paired campaign, not additional source-supplied raw observations.

EXPORT_ALLOWLIST.rule: Exact allowlist; payload hashes only; manifest lists itself without self-hashing. No raw sources or private files.

RELEASE_BOUNDARY.permitted: Original English prose, source-attributed factual parameters and independently authored contract tests only.
excluded: Publisher PDFs, XML and text dumps

review/independent_review.scope: Independent source-fidelity, static-contract and synthetic-bookkeeping review
confirmed: All fifteen focusing and fifteen splitter geometry rows agree with the source table; mirror mapping expands each fifteen-row design to thirty positions correctly.
The physical program is cylindrical-to-plane mapping under with/without panel conditions; focusing, splitting and model comparisons remain numerical or theoretical.
190 spatial positions and ten technical readouts per position are kept separate from independent specimens and campaigns; 3800 is explicitly arithmetic for a proposed complete pair.
The simulated 1 kPa amplitude is excluded from physical source-level settings, and absolute wavelength conversion remains gated.
The averaged source arrays are not included as new observations, and interpolated pixels do not increase measurement count.
All 44 operation templates are referenced by declared branches; their station, evidence and unknown-parameter IDs resolve.
Actor projection excludes evaluator outcomes, future observations, target fields and source-array values; the complete package is not claimed actor-visible.
Condition-state dependencies are exclusive and scoped; either matched condition order is accepted with location-aware panel cleanup.
Acquisition ordering preserves one-probe position intervals and retry ancestry instead of accepting stale pose receipts.
Calibration, part/panel inspection and condition setup/archive records are linked to corresponding current scoped events.

findings.finding: Condition start has incoming unconditional edges from both mutually exclusive panel states while a separate rule says one of them. A consumer that enforces every edge will require both states.
findings.requested_change: Represent condition-specific dependencies explicitly and test both condition orders without satisfying the other panel-state branch.

findings.finding: PANEL_RETURN presumes an installed panel even when the accepted with-then-without order finishes with the panel already removed.
findings.requested_change: Provide location-aware cleanup alternatives that remove an installed panel or inspect and return an already-carried/stored panel, without installing it again.

findings.finding: The current campaign checker accepts one generic receipt per operation template. It does not validate occurrence scope, dependency order, fabrication-job closure, per-microphone calibration sequences or per-condition configuration and closure occurrences. Template-label presence therefore does not establish the declared occurrence-level workflow.
findings.requested_change: Validate scoped occurrence records and their required dependency evidence, including repeated workflows; otherwise explicitly mark occurrence validation unimplemented and prevent the checker from claiming campaign completion.
findings.resolution: Scoped occurrence graph now covers finite job/part preparation, both microphone calibrations, both condition sequences, point-specific positioning/acquisition/averaging and cleanup. Single-probe moves wait for prior-point reads; retry events depend on superseded attempts. Inspection/calibration/configuration/archive records bind to occurrence IDs and current revisions.

findings.finding: The separate phase and transfer-direction card is absent from matched-state keys and readout epochs. Two conditions can therefore declare different complex conventions without the current shared-state comparison detecting it.
findings.requested_change: Bind the exact phase/transfer-convention revision to conditions and raw readouts and reject changes in the matched pair or during a point.

findings.finding: Panel position/row and grid x/y checks rely on Python set equality without strict integer types. Boolean True compares equal to integer one.
findings.requested_change: Reject booleans and non-integer position, row and grid-coordinate indices before set/mirror checks; add mutation tests.

review_limits: This is not hardware authentication, robot reachability, safety qualification or an acoustic experiment.

The actor projection is a declared boundary rather than an installed access-control loader. The full package must remain curator/evaluator-facing.
